text.text:
I’m very disappointed with my experience with Merchynt. I invested in their service with the expectation that it would help improve my Google rankings, increase visibility, and ultimately generate more leads for my business.

Unfortunately, the results have not matched those expectations. Despite having my Google Business Profile established for over a year and putting significant time and money into SEO, my rankings have remained disappointing and I have seen little to no meaningful increase in leads attributable to their service.

The biggest issue for me is the lack of measurable results. SEO takes time (90 to 120 days), but after following the recommended strategies and giving the process a fair opportunity, I expected to see more progress in rankings, visibility, and actual customer inquiries.

I also feel that there should have been much clearer communication about what was realistically being accomplished and why the results were not improving. Simply being told that SEO is competitive isn't enough when you're paying for a service specifically to improve your online presence.

I also see their social media posting 90-day results and ranking you # 1. That's not true and misleading, and it hurts small businesses.

The customer service and communication are lacking. Joshua, head of support, chooses when he wants to reply to your emails and doesn't seem eager to help you.

The platform looks cool, but it doesn't actually improve your SEO rankings. Before I started (April 8, 2026) with Merchynt, I was ranking in the top 16, and now some keywords are in the high 20s. I haven't seen an SEO lead come in for over 2 months. It's truly not worth the time and investment.

I wanted Merchynt to work, but based on my experience, I cannot recommend the service. If you're considering using them, I would strongly suggest asking for specific, measurable benchmarks for rankings, traffic, and leads before committing.

text.text:
We worked with the team at Brandefy since 2018, and choosing this Los Angeles–based video production company has been one of the best decisions we've made for our nonprofit. Over several years of our partnership, they've produced hundreds of brand videos and social media videos for us, including  more than 30 celebrity PSAs, as well as educational and awareness-oriented content in multiple languages, and the impact on our reach has been significant.

Brandefy's video production work helped us build a presence in 55 countries and generate over 15.5 million impressions across our social channels in just 18 months. We saw month-over-month growth that beat nonprofit industry averages: 16.2% monthly follower growth (vs. the 4.5% industry average), a 28% monthly increase in website views from social, a 45.6% email open rate (more than double the 21.3% nonprofit average), and a 12.4% click-through rate.

Marton and his team are responsive, transparent on pricing, and exceeded our expectations in every area. Marton now functions as a consultant across nearly every part of our organization. I rarely write reviews, but our brand wouldn't be where it is today without Brandefy. If you're looking for a video production company that delivers real marketing performance and not just nice-looking footage, I can't recommend Brandefy highly enough.

I can’t say enough good things about Brandefy.

I hired Brandefy to produce 36 video ads for Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and after interviewing several production companies, they clearly stood out. What ultimately sold me was how organized, structured, and well-thought-out their onboarding process was from the very beginning. It gave me immediate confidence that they understood not just video production, but performance marketing.

I work directly with Marton, the owner, and that alone sets Brandefy apart. He’s extremely experienced, knowledgeable, and—most importantly—hands-on throughout the entire process. From creative planning and shooting to editing and evaluating ROI across platforms, Marton is involved every step of the way, which is rare and incredibly valuable.

Everyone I’ve interacted with on Marton’s team has been friendly, professional, and highly competent. The entire experience has been smooth and efficient.

Most importantly, the results speak for themselves. The videos Brandefy produced are performing exceptionally well on Facebook and Instagram. I run multiple marketing channels—SEO, SEM, paid media, etc.—and Brandefy’s videos are delivering my best ROI by far, with the lowest customer acquisition cost of any source I use.

Because of the results and the overall experience, I fully plan to continue working with Brandefy on future video projects. If you’re serious about performance-driven video content and want a team that actually understands ROI, Brandefy is an easy recommendation.

Highly recommend.
